title: Move top-level logo and icon variants to `misc/logo`
body: - Related to #118699. This further tidies up the root folder of the repository, so it's now mainly: - `README.md` / `LICENSE.txt` / `COPYRIGHT.txt` / etc. i.e. typical top-level documentation. - Buildsystem entry point (`SConstruct`) and main definitions (`methods.py`, `version.py`). - Git and contribution tooling dotfiles (`.git*`, `.clang*`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, etc.). `pyproject.toml` is the odd one out that's not a dotfile, but there doesn't seem to be a dotfile equivalent sadly. - `bin`, `doc`, `misc`, and the rest are code folders. Together with #118699, it yields: On GitHub's repo view where dotfiles aren't hidden: Still pretty cluttered but not as bad as: --- ## Note I had thought of doing this multiple times in the past, but I always ended up considering that having `icon.svg` and `logo.svg` easy to find at the top-level was important, as folks often need them if they need to include a Godot logo somewhere. We have https://godotengine.org/press/ however which provides the same and more variants. It's not clear how much people rely on this Git repo for finding branding assets. Personally, I often grab one of the icons from the top-level if I e.g. create a Godot project with `touch project.godot` and end up lacking a nice `icon.svg` :) But I'll find my way to `misc/logo/` for this.
